changes: Worker records true timestamp gaps using already collected adjacent FrameStamp bounds. Missing or late results do not become idle estimates. Latest raw ticks are decimal strings to preserve precision. Timer enable/reset boundaries clear gap anchors.

Profile records wall time of actual surface acquisition including error outcomes, queue submit, and present enqueue separately. Bitmap presentation creates no fake acquisition sample. All added clocks/formatting run only with profiling.

Publisher skips Wine uploaded-generation query when optional preload is finished/off and no plan is pending. Planning and GPU atlas/backpressure limits remain intact. Actual queries get their own existing-profile span.
limitations: GPU inter-frame gap includes compositor pacing, uploads and other queue work; it cannot isolate GPU waiting only for CPU.
These changes do not themselves prove or achieve 240 FPS and do not prove removal of historical18.65-second UI publisher stall.
